name: Red Lion

layers.essential_history: This is where the walk starts and finishes. Nobody is quite sure how old the pub is: the village board says late 17th or early 18th century, while the village website says early 1800s.
layers.deeper_history: The village board says the toilet block by the pub was once the village fish and chip shop.
layers.mystery: [[c:The housekeeper catches you at the door. "A sealed order has gone missing, and the carter will be here for it this evening. Four people were near it: ]]Martha[[c: at the mill, ]]Jonas[[c: in the stables, ]]Alice[[c: the messenger and ]]Mr Vale[[c: the steward. Find out what each of them has to say."]]

puzzle.title: Whose story can't be true?
puzzle.intro: [[c:Here are three accounts of the afternoon, and a receipt. One of them can't be true. Can you spot which?]]
material: [[c:RECEIPT: the sealed order was handed into the dispatch room at the second bell. Signed for by the housekeeper.]]
MARTHA[[c:, miller's assistant: "I was at the mill all afternoon. I loaded the cart before the second bell and it left on time."]]
JONAS[[c:, stable hand: "I was in the yard with the horses. I saw ]]Alice[[c: ride in at the third bell with the order still in her bag."]]
ALICE[[c:, messenger: "I got to the dispatch room at the second bell and handed the order to the housekeeper."]]
puzzle.question: [[c:Whose story can't be true? Type their name.]]
hints: [[c:Check what time the receipt says the order was handed in.]]
[[c:Two of them mention the second bell. One of them mentions the third.]]
[[c:Someone says they saw the order in a bag after it had already been handed over.]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:The receipt says the order was handed in at the second bell, so ]]Jonas[[c: can't have seen it in ]]Alice[[c:'s bag at the third. Why would he say that? Keep it in mind.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:Can't get to the pub? You can still work this one out from the clues above.]]

evidence: Alice[[c: handed the order over safely at the second bell. The receipt proves it.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Follow the road south from the Red Lion towards the village centre. About 250 metres along you'll reach the Manor House, near Manor Place. Look from the road only.]]
notes: Optional refreshment stop. No purchase required.
No business partnership has been agreed with the pub.
support: [[c:Support the village: have a drink before your walk, or book a table for when you get back.]] [[c:The walk takes about 1 hr 30 depending on your pace, but allow up to 2 hr 30 if you stop to look around.]]
